evals.prompt: My Pixel 8 battery only lasts half a day now. Can I replace it myself? What do I need?
evals.expected_output: Resolves exact model (Pixel 8, not 8 Pro), fetches iFixit guide 166180 or equivalent, lists tools/parts/prereqs from the guide, flags battery discharge <25%, adhesive/IP68 seal loss, marks point of no return, cites guide URL. No invented screw counts.

assertions.name: exact_model
assertions.text: Distinguishes Pixel 8 from Pixel 8 Pro or confirms model

assertions.name: battery_safety
assertions.text: Mentions discharging battery and not puncturing/bending it

assertions.name: point_of_no_return
assertions.text: Identifies the step where adhesive/seal is broken

evals.prompt: My Lenovo ThinkCentre M715q mini PC is running hot. How do I repaste it?
evals.expected_output: Searches iFixit, reports no exact M715q guide, uses fallback ladder (sibling Tiny models / Lenovo HMM / thermal paste technique guide), labels the result as approximate, ESD precautions.

assertions.name: admits_no_exact_guide
assertions.text: States that no exact M715q guide exists or that the guide used is for another model

assertions.name: uses_fallback
assertions.text: Suggests Lenovo HMM or a sibling ThinkCentre Tiny guide or a thermal paste technique guide

evals.prompt: The battery in my old laptop is bulging and the trackpad is lifting. Should I just pry it out?
evals.expected_output: Stops the user: swollen battery protocol — don't charge, don't compress or pry against the cell, remove only without pressure, fire-safe storage, proper disposal (Wertstoffhof / retailer take-back). Then asks for the exact laptop model to fetch the guide.

assertions.name: no_prying
assertions.text: Advises against prying/applying pressure to the swollen cell

assertions.name: disposal
assertions.text: Mentions proper battery disposal (not household waste)

assertions.name: asks_model
assertions.text: Asks for or uses the exact laptop model before giving steps
